run_eyegaze_depth_estimator: run the eye gaze depth estimator on a VRS file with eye gaze data to estimate depth
create_GazeDepthEstimator: create a GazeDepthEstimator instance with a VRS data provider to compute gaze depth via patch matching
get_depth_scores_for_gaze: get depth scores and estimates for a single eye gaze sample using the GazeDepthEstimator
export_to_csv: export a list of GazeWithDepthEstimate objects to a CSV file with gaze and depth columns
get_image_projections: project 3D CPF points to 2D image sensor coordinates using camera calibration and extrinsics
